name: How long does unattended death cleanup usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does unattended death cleanup usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of unattended death cleanup depends on the severity of the situation, the extent of decomposition, and the size of the affected area. A relatively contained and minor incident might be completed within a day. However, more complex scenarios involving significant structural damage, widespread contamination, or multiple affected rooms can take several days to a week or more to thoroughly clean, disinfect, and deodorize. An initial assessment can provide a more accurate timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleanup time varies from one day to over a week, depending on the severity of decomposition, contamination extent, and the size of the affected area.
